skills.trigger: When evaluating a chest X-ray showing unilateral pleural effusion to determine the underlying etiology based on distribution patterns.
steps: Inspect the pleural spaces to determine if the effusion is unilateral or bilateral.
If the effusion is strictly unilateral, exclude systemic causes like congestive heart failure which typically present with bilateral findings.
Correlate the unilateral finding with clinical signs of infection (e.g., fever) to support a diagnosis of parapneumonic effusion over non-infectious causes.
